privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.intro: At <1>SialConnect</1>, we value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This policy outlines how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you use our services.

items.personal: Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number, business details.
items.usage: Usage Data: Log data, IP address, browser type, interactions with features (e.g., bidding, chat).
items.cookies: Cookies: We may use cookies for session management, language preferences, and analytics.

items.provide: To provide, maintain, and improve our services.
items.facilitate: To facilitate communication between exporters and suppliers.
items.secure: To ensure secure access through authentication and verification.
items.personalize: To personalize product recommendations and user experience.
items.notifications: To send notifications related to bids, messages, and updates.

section3.title: 3. Data Sharing & Disclosure
section3.text: We do <1>not</1> sell or rent your personal data to third parties. Data may be shared with trusted service providers (e.g., hosting, authentication) strictly to operate our platform. All third-party services comply with data protection standards.

section4.title: 4. Data Security
section4.text: We use encryption, secure servers, and access controls to protect your data. Sensitive data such as passwords are hashed and never stored in plain text.

items.access: Access your data and account information.
items.correct: Request correction or deletion of your data.

section6.title: 6. Data Retention
section6.text: We retain user data as long as your account is active or as needed to fulfill legal, contractual, or platform obligations. You may request data deletion at any time.

section7.title: 7. Third-Party Links
section7.text: Our platform may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for their privacy practices. Please review their policies separately.

section8.title: 8. Children's Privacy
section8.text: Our platform is not intended for users under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors.

section9.title: 9. Policy Updates
section9.text: This privacy policy may be updated occasionally. Changes will be posted here with the revised date. Continued use of the platform implies acceptance of updates.
